title.ja: Make Tide with NexT1DE : 長沙スナックアドベンチャー

transcript.text: Today, we are very happy. Our NexT1DE has come to our Changsha station.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 今日、僕たちはとても嬉しいです。僕たちのネクタイデが長沙の駅に来てくれました。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Today , we are very happy . Our NexT 1 DE has come to our Changsha station .

translations.ja: 今日は本当に嬉しいな。僕たちのNexT1DE（※ファンダム名）が長沙の駅に会いに来てくれたよ
translations.en: Today, we are very happy. Our NexT1DE has come to our Changsha station.
translations.ko: 오늘 우리는 정말 행복합니다. 저희 NexT1DE가 창사역에 도착했습니다.
translations.zh-TW: 今天我們非常開心，我們的 NexT1DE 來到了我們的長沙站。
translations.id: Hari ini, kami sangat senang. NexT1DE kami telah tiba di stasiun Changsha kami.
translations.pt: Hoje, estamos muito felizes. O nosso NexT1DE chegou à nossa estação de Changsha.

transcript.text: Changsha we unlocked the next stop on our map. And we are very, very happy.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 長沙でマップの次のストップをアンロックしました。そして、僕たちはとても、とても嬉しいです。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Changsha we unlocked the next stop on our map . And we are very , very happy .

translations.ja: 長沙でマップの新しい目的地をアンロックしたんだ。それに、すごくすごく嬉しいよ
translations.en: Changsha we unlocked the next stop on our map. And we are very, very happy.
translations.ko: 창사, 지도의 다음 목적지를 해제했습니다. 그리고 우리는 정말 정말 행복합니다.
translations.zh-TW: 長沙，我們解鎖了地圖上的下一站，我們真的非常非常開心。
translations.id: Changsha, kami membuka perhentian berikutnya di peta kami. Dan kami sangat, sangat senang.
translations.pt: Changsha, desbloqueamos a próxima paragem no nosso mapa. E estamos muito, muito felizes.

transcript.text: Then we will now be explained to us by SHEN these Changsha delicacies on our table what they are. What?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: それでは、テーブルの上にある長沙の名物料理が何なのか、シェンが説明してくれます。何ですか？
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Then we will now be explained to us by SHEN these Changsha delicacies on our table what they are . What ?

translations.ja: それじゃあ、テーブルに並んだ長沙の美味しい名物たちをシェンが説明してくれるよ。どれどれ？
translations.en: Then we will now be explained to us by SHEN these Changsha delicacies on our table what they are. What?
translations.ko: 그럼 이제 SHEN이 우리 테이블 위에 있는 이 창사 진미들이 무엇인지 설명해 주실 겁니다. 무엇인가요?
translations.zh-TW: 接下來，由 SHEN 來為我們講解桌上這些長沙美食到底是什麼。是什麼？
translations.id: Sekarang kita akan dijelaskan oleh SHEN tentang makanan khas Changsha di meja kita ini, apa saja itu. Apa?
translations.pt: Então agora o SHEN vai explicar-nos que iguarias de Changsha são estas na nossa mesa. O quê?

transcript.text: This is Tangyou Tuo Tuo from Changsha.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: これは長沙のタンヨウ・トゥオトゥオです。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: This is Tangyou Tuo Tuo from Changsha .

translations.ja: これは長沙の糖油粑粑（タンヨウ・ババ ※揚げ餅の甘いおやつ）だよ
translations.en: This is Tangyou Tuo Tuo from Changsha.
translations.ko: 이것은 창사의 탕유퉈퉈입니다.
translations.zh-TW: 這是長沙的糖油粑粑。
translations.id: Ini adalah Tangyou Tuo Tuo dari Changsha.
translations.pt: Isto é Tangyou Tuo Tuo de Changsha.

transcript.text: Tangyou Tuo Tuo is sweet I like it. Here it is. I kind of forgot.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: タンヨウ・トゥオトゥオは甘くて好きです。これです。ちょっと忘れちゃいました。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Tangyou Tuo Tuo is sweet I like it . Here it is . I kind of forgot .

translations.ja: 糖油粑粑は甘くて好きなんだよね。これこれ。ちょっと忘れちゃったけど
translations.en: Tangyou Tuo Tuo is sweet I like it. Here it is. I kind of forgot.
translations.ko: 탕유퉈퉈는 달콤해서 마음에 들어요. 여기 있어요. 좀 깜빡했네요.

translations.pt: Tangyou Tuo Tuo é doce, eu gosto. Aqui está. Meio que me esqueci.

transcript.text: Someone help me explain The thing inside.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 誰か中のものについて説明を手伝ってください。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Someone help me explain The thing inside .

translations.ja: 誰か中身について説明するのを手伝ってよ
translations.en: Someone help me explain The thing inside.
translations.ko: 안에 든 게 뭔지 설명하는 것 좀 도와주세요.
translations.zh-TW: 誰來幫我解釋一下裡面的東西。
translations.id: Seseorang tolong bantu aku menjelaskan apa yang ada di dalamnya.
translations.pt: Alguém me ajuda a explicar o que está lá dentro.

transcript.text: Roujiamo Roujiamo is from Xi'an, right? What is it? It's a pie. It's a pie.

transcript.pronunciation_roman: Roujiamo Roujiamo is from Xi 'an, right ? What is it ? It 's a pie . It 's a pie .

translations.ja: 肉夾饃（ロウジアモー ※中国式バーガー）って西安のものだよね？これなんだっけ？パイみたいなやつだ
translations.en: Roujiamo Roujiamo is from Xi'an, right? What is it? It's a pie. It's a pie.
translations.ko: 로우지아모, 로우지아모는 시안 거 맞죠? 그게 뭐죠? 파이예요. 파이입니다.
translations.zh-TW: 肉夾饃？肉夾饃是西安的吧？這是什麼？這是一個餅，是一個餅。
translations.id: Roujiamo. Roujiamo berasal dari Xi'an, kan? Apa ini? Ini pai. Ini pai.
translations.pt: Roujiamo. Roujiamo é de Xi'an, certo? O que é? É uma tarte. É uma tarte.

transcript.text: And this is braised. Marinated food. This is coriander beef.

translations.en: And this is braised. Marinated food. This is coriander beef.
translations.ko: 그리고 이건 조림이에요. 양념된 음식. 이건 고수 소고기입니다.
translations.zh-TW: 這個是滷味，滷製品。這是香菜牛肉。
translations.id: Dan ini direbus. Makanan yang dimarinasi. Ini daging sapi ketumbar.
translations.pt: E isto é cozinhado. Comida marinada. Isto é carne de vaca com coentros.

transcript.text: This is stinky tofu.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: これは臭豆腐です。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: This is stinky tofu .

translations.ja: そしてこれは臭豆腐（チョウトウフ）だよ
translations.en: This is stinky tofu.
translations.ko: 이건 취두부입니다.
translations.zh-TW: 這是臭豆腐。
translations.id: Ini tahu busuk.
translations.pt: Isto é tofu fedido.

transcript.text: Love to eat And this is jelly. This is egg soup. It's the kind of Sweet Fermented Rice.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 食べるのが大好きで、そしてこれはゼリーです。これはエッグスープです。甘い発酵米のタイプです。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Love to eat And this is jelly . This is egg soup . It 's the kind of Sweet Fermented Rice .

translations.ja: 食べるの大好き！それからこれはデザートのゼリーで、卵スープ。甘い発酵米が入ってるやつだね
translations.en: Love to eat And this is jelly. This is egg soup. It's the kind of Sweet Fermented Rice.
translations.ko: 먹는 걸 좋아해요. 그리고 이건 젤리예요. 이건 계란국이에요. 달콤한 발효 쌀 같은 거예요.
translations.zh-TW: 愛吃，這個是涼粉，這是蛋湯，就是那種酒釀。
translations.id: Suka makan. Dan ini jeli. Ini sup telur. Ini jenis Nasi Ketan Fermentasi yang manis.
translations.pt: Adoro comer. E isto é gelatina. Isto é sopa de ovo. É daquele tipo de Arroz Doce Fermentado.

transcript.text: glutinous rice Sweet Fermented Rice I'm sorry. Here it is. I kind of forgot.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: もち米、甘い発酵米、すみません。これです。ちょっと忘れちゃいました。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: glutinous rice Sweet Fermented Rice I 'm sorry . Here it is . I kind of forgot .

translations.ja: もち米と甘い発酵米……っと、ごめん！これこれ、ちょっと忘れちゃった
translations.en: glutinous rice Sweet Fermented Rice I'm sorry. Here it is. I kind of forgot.
translations.ko: 찹쌀, 달콤한 발효 쌀 죄송해요. 여기 있어요. 좀 깜빡했네요.
translations.zh-TW: 糯米，酒釀，不好意思。給你。我有點忘了。
translations.id: Nasi ketan. Nasi Ketan Fermentasi, maaf. Ini dia. Aku agak lupa.
translations.pt: Arroz glutinoso. Arroz Doce Fermentado, desculpem. Aqui está. Meio que me esqueci.

transcript.text: This is egg soup. What about this? Ah? Oh. Here it is. Is this an egg?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: これはエッグスープです。これは何ですか？あぁ？おぉ。これです。これは卵ですか？
transcript.pronunciation_roman: This is egg soup . What about this ? Ah ? Oh . Here it is . Is this an egg ?

translations.ja: こっちは卵スープ。じゃあこれは？あれ？おっ、これだ。これって卵かな？
translations.en: This is egg soup. What about this? Ah? Oh. Here it is. Is this an egg?
translations.ko: 이건 계란국이에요. 이건 뭔가요? 아? 오. 여기 있어요. 이거 계란인가요?
translations.zh-TW: 這是蛋湯。那這個呢？啊？哦。給你。這是一個蛋嗎？
translations.id: Ini sup telur. Bagaimana dengan ini? Ah? Oh. Ini dia. Apakah ini telur?
translations.pt: Isto é sopa de ovo. E isto? Ah? Oh. Aqui está. Isto é um ovo?

transcript.text: This is a larger Tangyou Tuo Tuo Wonton.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: これは大きめのタンヨウ・トゥオトゥオ、ワンタンです。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: This is a larger Tangyou Tuo Tuo Wonton .

translations.ja: こっちは大きめの糖油粑粑とワンタンだね
translations.en: This is a larger Tangyou Tuo Tuo Wonton.
translations.ko: 이건 더 큰 탕유퉈퉈 완탕입니다.
translations.zh-TW: 這是一個大號的糖油粑粑……餛飩？
translations.id: Ini Tangyou Tuo Tuo Wonton yang lebih besar.
translations.pt: Isto é um Tangyou Tuo Tuo Wonton maior.

transcript.text: scallion oil Scallion pancake. Scallion pancake. Three yuan each. What is this? Mung bean cake?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ネギ油。ネギパンケーキ。ネギパンケーキ。1つ3元。これは何ですか？緑豆ケーキ？
transcript.pronunciation_roman: scallion oil Scallion pancake . Scallion pancake . Three yuan each . What is this ? Mung bean cake ?

translations.ja: ネギ油の、ネギパンケーキ！ネギパンケーキだ。1つ3元だって。これは何？緑豆ケーキ？
translations.en: scallion oil Scallion pancake. Scallion pancake. Three yuan each. What is this? Mung bean cake?
translations.ko: 파기름, 파전. 파전. 개당 3위안. 이게 뭐죠? 녹두 케이크인가요?
translations.zh-TW: 蔥油……蔥油餅。蔥油餅。三個三塊錢。這是什麼？綠豆糕？
translations.id: Minyak daun bawang. Kue daun bawang. Kue daun bawang. Tiga yuan masing-masing. Apa ini? Kue kacang hijau?
translations.pt: Óleo de cebolinho. Panqueca de cebolinho. Panqueca de cebolinho. Três yuans cada. O que é isto? Bolo de feijão-mungo?

transcript.text: Mung bean cake Ai Zi Pie. Ai Zi Pie.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 緑豆ケーキ、アイズー・パイ。アイズー・パイ。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Mung bean cake Ai Zi Pie . Ai Zi Pie .

translations.ja: 緑豆ケーキと、艾粑粑（アイズー・パイ ※ヨモギ餅）だ
translations.en: Mung bean cake Ai Zi Pie. Ai Zi Pie.
translations.ko: 녹두 케이크. 아이즈파이. 아이즈파이.
translations.zh-TW: 綠豆糕，艾滋粑。艾滋粑。
translations.id: Kue kacang hijau. Pai Ai Zi. Pai Ai Zi.
translations.pt: Bolo de feijão-mungo. Tarte Ai Zi. Tarte Ai Zi.

transcript.text: And then next, we will play a game.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: そして次に、ゲームをします。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And then next , we will play a game .

translations.ja: それじゃあ次は、ゲームをしよう
translations.en: And then next, we will play a game.
translations.ko: 그리고 다음으로 게임을 하겠습니다.
translations.zh-TW: 然後接下來，我們要玩一個遊戲。
translations.id: Dan selanjutnya, kita akan bermain sebuah game.
translations.pt: E a seguir, vamos jogar um jogo.

transcript.text: That is, each of us will have one on our head Didn't let you eat it, can he eat it? Can i eat it? Yes,you can. Eat later. there will be a card on our head.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: つまり、一人ずつ頭に……食べさせてあげないのに、彼は食べられるの？僕は食べられる？はい、どうぞ。後で食べます。頭にカードが乗ります。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: That is , each of us will have one on our head Didn 't let you eat it , can he eat it ? Can i eat it ? Yes ,you can . Eat later . there will be a card on our head .

translations.ja: ルールはこう。みんなの頭にカードを乗せるんだけど……まだ食べちゃダメなのに、彼は食べていいの？僕食べていい？うん、いいよ。あとで食べよう。頭にカードが乗るんだ
translations.en: That is, each of us will have one on our head Didn't let you eat it, can he eat it? Can i eat it? Yes,you can. Eat later. there will be a card on our head.
translations.ko: 즉, 우리 각자의 머리에 하나씩... 아직 먹지 말라고 했는데, 먹어도 되나요? 제가 먹어도 되나요? 네, 드셔도 돼요. 나중에 드세요. 머리에 카드가 붙을 거예요.
translations.zh-TW: 也就是說，我們每個人頭上都會……不是不讓你吃，他能吃嗎？我能吃嗎？可以，等會兒吃。我們頭上會有一張卡片。
translations.id: Yaitu, kita masing-masing akan mengenakan sesuatu di kepala kita... Belum boleh memakannya, apakah dia boleh memakannya? Bolehkah aku memakannya? Ya, boleh. Makan nanti. Akan ada kartu di kepala kita.
translations.pt: Ou seja, cada um de nós terá um na cabeça... Não deixaste ele comer, ele pode comer? Posso comer? Sim, podes. Come mais logo. Haverá um cartão na nossa cabeça.

transcript.text: And then we're going to trick other people into making that card (the word on it) Once he makes it, he's out.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: そして、他の人をだましてそのカード（そこに書かれた言葉）を言わせます。言わせたら、その人の負けです。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And then we 're going to trick other people into making that card (the word on it ) Once he makes it , he 's out .

translations.ja: そして、他のメンバーを巧みに誘導して、自分の頭にあるカードの言葉を言わせるの。言わせたらその人の負けね
translations.en: And then we're going to trick other people into making that card (the word on it) Once he makes it, he's out.
translations.ko: 그리고 나서 다른 사람들이 그 카드(그 위의 단어)를 행동으로 유도하게 만드는 거예요. 그가 그걸 해내면 탈락입니다.
translations.zh-TW: 然後我們要引誘其他人做出那張卡片（上面的詞）的動作。只要他做出來了，他就出局了。
translations.id: Dan kemudian kita akan menjebak orang lain untuk membuat kartu tersebut (kata yang ada di dalamnya) terucap. Begitu dia mengucapkannya, dia kalah.
translations.pt: E depois vamos enganar os outros para fazerem com que esse cartão (a palavra nele) seja usado. Assim que ele o fizer, está eliminado.

transcript.text: OK. Let's start playing this game. Stop eating.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: わかりました。このゲームを始めましょう。食べるのをやめて。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: OK . Let 's start playing this game . Stop eating .

translations.ja: オッケー、それじゃあゲームスタート！食べるのストップね
translations.en: OK. Let's start playing this game. Stop eating.
translations.ko: 좋습니다. 이 게임을 시작합시다. 먹는 거 그만해요.
translations.zh-TW: 好，我們開始玩這個遊戲。別吃了。
translations.id: Baiklah. Mari kita mulai permainan ini. Berhenti makan.
translations.pt: OK. Vamos começar a jogar este jogo. Parem de comer.

transcript.text: Then we each round you can choose two kinds of food you want to taste.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: それから各ラウンド、味見したい食べ物を2種類選ぶことができます。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Then we each round you can choose two kinds of food you want to taste .

translations.ja: 各ラウンドで、味見したい食べ物を2種類選べるよ
translations.en: Then we each round you can choose two kinds of food you want to taste.
translations.ko: 그럼 매 라운드마다 맛보고 싶은 음식을 두 가지씩 고를 수 있습니다.
translations.zh-TW: 然後我們每輪可以選擇兩種你想品嚐的食物。
translations.id: Kemudian di setiap ronde, kamu dapat memilih dua jenis makanan yang ingin kamu cicipi.
translations.pt: Então, em cada ronda, podem escolher dois tipos de comida que querem provar.

transcript.text: Let's start playing. Then everyone put on that thing on their head. Let's invite our men in black to deal the cards.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: プレイを始めましょう。それではみんな頭にそのものを装着して。黒服のスタッフさん、カードを配ってください。
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Let 's start playing . Then everyone put on that thing on their head . Let 's invite our men in black to deal the cards .

translations.ja: それじゃあプレイ開始！みんな頭にそれを装着して。黒服のスタッフさん、カード配りをお願いします！
translations.en: Let's start playing. Then everyone put on that thing on their head. Let's invite our men in black to deal the cards.
translations.ko: 게임을 시작합시다. 자, 모두 머리에 그 물건을 쓰세요. 블랙맨 분들을 초대해 카드를 나눠달라고 합시다.
translations.zh-TW: 我們開始玩吧。然後大家把那個頭飾戴上。我們請黑衣人來發牌。
translations.id: Mari kita mulai bermain. Lalu semuanya kenakan benda itu di kepala kalian. Mari kita undang pria berpakaian hitam kita untuk membagikan kartu.
translations.pt: Vamos começar a jogar. Então, ponham todos essa coisa na cabeça. Vamos convidar os nossos homens de preto para distribuir as cartas.

transcript.text: I got two. The transparent light is on. He's watching. Caught ya!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 2枚引いちゃった。透明なライトがついてます。見てるよ。捕まえた！
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I got two . The transparent light is on . He 's watching . Caught ya !

translations.ja: 2枚引いちゃったよ。透明なライトが光ってる。見てるぞ〜、捕まえた！
translations.en: I got two. The transparent light is on. He's watching. Caught ya!
translations.ko: 난 두 개 뽑았어. 투명한 불이 켜졌어. 그가 보고 있어. 딱 걸렸어!
translations.zh-TW: 我抽到兩個。透明燈亮了。他在看。抓到了！
translations.id: Aku dapat dua. Lampu transparan menyala. Dia sedang memerhatikan. Kena kau!
translations.pt: Tive dois. A luz transparente está acesa. Ele está a ver. Apanhado!

transcript.text: re-draw XIONG, you draw for him. This one. This one.

transcript.pronunciation_roman: re-draw XIONG , you draw for him . This one . This one .

translations.ko: 다시 뽑아. XIONG, 그를 위해 네가 뽑아줘. 이거. 이거.
